instructions:
1. Sit at the cable machine with feet flat and knees under the pads. Grasp a single handle on the high pulley with your right hand, arm fully extended overhead, palm facing forward.
2. Pull the handle down toward your right shoulder, driving your elbow down and back.
3. Squeeze your shoulder blade down as you reach the bottom.
4. Slowly extend your arm back overhead under control.
5. Finish all reps, then switch to the left hand.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you pull down and inhale as you extend back up.
2. Keep your torso facing forward and resist any twisting.
3. Lead with the elbow, not the hand, to load the lat.
4. Use a full stretch at the top for the most range.
name: Cable one arm lat pulldown

instructions:
1. Stand between two cable pulleys set at the highest position. Grasp a handle in each hand, palms facing up, arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height.
2. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and back straight.
3. Curl the handles toward your head by bending your elbows, keeping upper arms fixed.
4. Squeeze your biceps at the top.
5. Slowly extend your arms back out under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you curl in and inhale as you extend out.
2. Keep your upper arms still at shoulder height throughout.
3. Move only at the elbows, not the shoulders.
4. Use a controlled tempo to keep tension on the biceps.
name: Cable overhead curl

instructions:
1. Attach a rope to the high pulley. Stand with your back to the machine and grasp the rope with both hands, palms facing each other.
2. Step forward to create tension and raise your arms overhead, elbows close to your head.
3. Extend your arms straight up by contracting your triceps.
4. Bend your elbows to lower the rope behind your head, keeping upper arms still.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid using momentum.
2. Squeeze the triceps hard at full extension.
3. Exhale as you extend and inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your elbows pointing forward and close to your head.
name: Cable overhead extension rope

instructions:
1. Stand facing a cable machine with feet shoulder-width apart. Attach a single handle to a mid-height pulley and hold it with your right hand, palm facing down.
2. Bend slightly at the hips and knees with a straight back, and extend your right arm forward.
3. Pull the handle toward your torso, rotating your palm up as your elbow draws back close to your side.
4. Slowly extend your arm forward, rotating your palm back down.
5. Finish all reps, then switch to the left hand.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze your shoulder blade back at the end of the pull.
2. Keep your torso square and resist twisting toward the cable.
3. Exhale as you pull and inhale as you extend.
4. Start light to control the palm rotation cleanly.
name: Cable palm rotational row

instructions:
1. Set a preacher bench in front of a low pulley and sit with feet flat. Attach a straight bar and grasp it with both hands shoulder-width apart, palms up.
2. Rest your upper arms on the bench pad and extend your arms fully.
3. Curl the bar toward your shoulders by bending your elbows.
4. Squeeze your biceps at the top.
5. Lower the bar back to full extension under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you curl up and inhale as you lower.
2. Keep your upper arms flat on the pad the whole set.
3. Control the lowering phase for a full stretch.
4. Keep wrists neutral to avoid strain.
name: Cable preacher curl
